description: This Dart source file is a Flutter widget implementation for the home screen of a notes app. It defines the main layout, including a top bar with layout toggles, a notes display area with list and grid views, side menu (rail and drawer), and navigation actions for creating and viewing notes.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: StatelessWidget representing the main screen layout of the notes application.

classes.name: _TopBar
classes.description: StatelessWidget for rendering the top app bar, including title, layout toggle, and drawer icon.

classes.name: _NotesArea
classes.description: StatelessWidget that displays notes either as a list or grid, with loading and error handling.

classes.name: _SideMenuRail
classes.description: StatelessWidget rendering a navigation rail for category selection on wide screens.

classes.name: _SideMenuDrawer
classes.description: StatelessWidget rendering a drawer menu for category selection on narrow screens.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for each widget class to describe their UI structure.
